headline: UPDATE to totw-20261024-0500-01 (Oleshky localized ceasefire) -- Zelensky
dek: Zelensky said negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the US agreed to technical-level meetings in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi, hoping for a leaders' meeting to follow. A US official said the three countries may hold their next talks in a couple of weeks in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland.
sources: Volodymyr Zelensky (statement), US official (unnamed), Melania Trump (statement), White House (statement)
fault_line: Announcement-first diplomacy: does a ceasefire negotiated by a First Lady hold where armies and envoys failed?

sections.what_happened: Zelensky said negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the US agreed to technical-level meetings in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi, hoping for a leaders' meeting to follow. A US official said the three countries may hold their next talks in a couple of weeks in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland. Both sides credit Melania Trump with brokering the Oleshky ceasefire. White House: Oleshky's population has fallen from 24,000 before the war to 1,700-2,000.
sections.what_verified: Zelensky's Abu Dhabi statement carried by GMA, Dunya News, Prothom Alo, Aaj TV, DZRH (undeclared tiers, 5 independent families). Reuters T1 carries Lubinets' demining/aid detail. No wire seen carrying the Abu Dhabi-schedule quote itself in-window.
sections.what_disputed: Abu Dhabi/Switzerland venue and timing unconfirmed by Moscow in-window. Whether corridors actually open Oct 27 is the credibility test.
sections.why_matters: The first face-to-face negotiating table since the rift: Abu Dhabi, early November. Watch whether the Oleshky corridors actually open Oct 27 -- that is the credibility test.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to totw-20261024-0500-01 (Oleshky localized ceasefire) -- Zelensky: negotiators agreed to technical-level meetings in first half of November in Abu Dhabi; US official: talks in 'a couple of weeks in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland'; both sides credit Melania Trump with brokering; White House: Oleshky population 24,000 -> 1,700-2,000

totw_analysis: Our read: The first face-to-face negotiating table since the rift: Abu Dhabi, early November. Watch whether the Oleshky corridors actually open Oct 27 -- that is the credibility test. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Announcement-first diplomacy: does a ceasefire negotiated by a First Lady hold where armies and envoys failed?
